in_sanskrit.name: हिर्दय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: हृदयम् (hṛdayam) - the heart or the mind.

in_marathi.name: Hirday
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hirday हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hirday in Sanskrit represents the deepest part of an individual's being, encompassing both heart and mind. This name invokes a sense of wisdom, understanding, and inner strength.
